verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: קַ֤ח אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו אִתֹּ֔ו וְאֵת֙ הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה וְאֵ֣ת ׀ פַּ֣ר הֽ͏ַחַטָּ֗את וְאֵת֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָֽאֵילִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת סַ֥ל הַמַּצֹּֽות׃
verses.ar: «خُذْ هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ مَعَهُ، وَٱلثِّيَابَ وَدُهْنَ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَثَوْرَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ وَٱلْكَبْشَيْنِ وَسَلَّ ٱلْفَطِيرِ،
verses.en: 'Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bullock of the sin-offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
verses.kjv: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.web: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

verses.he: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־הָעֵדָ֖ה הַקְהֵ֑ל אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: وَٱجْمَعْ كُلَّ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ إِلَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ».
verses.en: and assemble thou all the congregation at the door of the tent of meeting.'
verses.kjv: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

verses.he: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כּֽ͏ַאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹתֹ֑ו וַתִּקָּהֵל֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: فَفَعَلَ مُوسَى كَمَا أَمَرَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ. فَٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةُ إِلَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הָעֵדָ֑ה זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹֽׂות׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ مُوسَى لِلْجَمَاعَةِ: «هَذَا مَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَنْ يُفْعَلَ».
verses.en: And Moses said unto the congregation: 'This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded to be done.'
verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
verses.web: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

verses.he: וַיַּקְרֵ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֑יו וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.ar: فَقَدَّمَ مُوسَى هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ وَغَسَّلَهُمْ بِمَاءٍ.
verses.en: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.web: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן עָלָ֜יו אֶת־הַכֻּתֹּ֗נֶת וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתֹו֙ בָּֽאַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתֹו֙ אֶֽת־הַמְּעִ֔יל וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עָלָ֖יו אֶת־הָאֵפֹ֑ד וַיַּחְגֹּ֣ר אֹתֹ֗ו בְּחֵ֙שֶׁב֙ הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד וַיֶּאְפֹּ֥ד לֹ֖ו בֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَمِيصَ وَنَطَّقَهُ بِٱلْمِنْطَقَةِ وَأَلْبَسَهُ ٱلْجُبَّةَ وَجَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلرِّدَاءَ، وَنَطَّقَهُ بِزُنَّارِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ وَشَدَّهُ بِهِ.
verses.en: And he put upon him the tunic, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
verses.kjv: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound [it] unto him therewith.
verses.web: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

verses.he: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם עָלָ֖יו אֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶל־הַחֹ֔שֶׁן אֶת־הָאוּרִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַתֻּמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَوَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلصُّدْرَةَ وَجَعَلَ فِي ٱلصُّدْرَةِ ٱلْأُورِيمَ وَٱلتُّمِّيمَ.
verses.en: And he placed the breastplate upon him; and in the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.kjv: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.web: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

verses.he: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל־רֹאשֹׁ֑ו וַיָּ֨שֶׂם עַֽל־הַמִּצְנֶ֜פֶת אֶל־מ֣וּל פָּנָ֗יו אֵ֣ת צִ֤יץ הַזָּהָב֙ נֵ֣זֶר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَوَضَعَ ٱلْعِمَامَةَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، وَوَضَعَ عَلَى ٱلْعِمَامَةِ إِلَى جِهَةِ وَجْهِهِ صَفِيحَةَ ٱلذَّهَبِ، ٱلْإِكْلِيلَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And he set the mitre upon his head; and upon the mitre, in front, did he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, [even] upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בֹּ֑ו וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مُوسَى دُهْنَ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَمَسَحَ ٱلْمَسْكَنَ وَكُلَّ مَا فِيهِ وَقَدَّسَهُ،
verses.en: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
verses.kjv: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that [was] therein, and sanctified them.
verses.web: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥ז מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֗יו וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֛ר וְאֶת־כַּנֹּ֖ו לְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: وَنَضَحَ مِنْهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ، وَمَسَحَ ٱلْمَذْبَحَ وَجَمِيعَ آنِيَتِهِ، وَٱلْمِرْحَضَةَ وَقَاعِدَتَهَا لِتَقْدِيسِهَا.
verses.en: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the laver and its base, to sanctify them.
verses.kjv: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.web: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

verses.he: וַיִּצֹק֙ מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֹתֹ֖ו לְקַדְּשֹֽׁו׃
verses.ar: وَصَبَّ مِنْ دُهْنِ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ عَلَى رَأْسِ هَارُونَ وَمَسَحَهُ لِتَقْدِيسِهِ.
verses.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.kjv: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.web: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

verses.he: וַיַּקְרֵ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁ֤ם כֻּתֳּנֹת֙ וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ אַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּחֲבֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם מִגְבָּעֹ֑ות כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَدَّمَ مُوسَى بَنِي هَارُونَ وَأَلْبَسَهُمْ أَقْمِصَةً وَنَطَّقَهُمْ بِمَنَاطِقَ وَشَدَّ لَهُمْ قَلَانِسَ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and clothed them with tunics, and girded them with girdles, and bound head-tires upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיַּגֵּ֕שׁ אֵ֖ת פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וַיִּסְמֹ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־רֹ֖אשׁ פַּ֥ר הֽ͏ַחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَدَّمَ ثَوْرَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ، وَوَضَعَ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى رَأْسِ ثَوْرِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ.
verses.en: And the bullock of the sin-offering was brought; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock of the sin-offering.
verses.kjv: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.web: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁחָ֗ט וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־הַדָּם֙ וַ֠יִּתֵּן עַל־קַרְנֹ֨ות הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ סָבִיב֙ בְּאֶצְבָּעֹ֔ו וַיְחַטֵּ֖א אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־הַדָּ֗ם יָצַק֙ אֶל־יְסֹ֣וד הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֖הוּ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.ar: فَذَبَحَهُ، وَأَخَذَ مُوسَى ٱلدَّمَ وَجَعَلَهُ عَلَى قُرُونِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا بِإِصْبَعِهِ، وَطَهَّرَ ٱلْمَذْبَحَ. ثُمَّ صَبَّ ٱلدَّمَ إِلَى أَسْفَلِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ وَقَدَّسَهُ تَكْفِيرًا عَنْهُ.
verses.en: And when it was slain, Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the remaining blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
verses.kjv: And he slew [it;] and Moses took the blood, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.web: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֗ח אֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.ar: وَأَخَذَ كُلَّ ٱلشَّحْمِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْأَحْشَاءِ وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ وَشَحْمَهُمَا، وَأَوْقَدَهُ مُوسَى عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses made it smoke upon the altar.
verses.kjv: And he took all the fat that [was] upon the inwards, and the caul [above] the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned [it] upon the altar.
verses.web: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

verses.he: וְאֶת־הַפָּ֤ר וְאֶת־עֹרֹו֙ וְאֶת־בְּשָׂרֹ֣ו וְאֶת־פִּרְשֹׁ֔ו שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلثَّوْرُ: جِلْدُهُ وَلَحْمُهُ وَفَرْثُهُ، فَأَحْرَقَهُ بِنَارٍ خَارِجَ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: But the bullock, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, were burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת אֵ֣יל הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَدَّمَ كَبْشَ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ، فَوَضَعَ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْكَبْشِ.
verses.en: And the ram of the burnt-offering was presented; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.kjv: ¶ And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.web: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁחָ֑ט וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: فَذَبَحَهُ، وَرَشَّ مُوسَى ٱلدَّمَ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا.
verses.en: And when it was killed, Moses dashed the blood against the altar round about.
verses.kjv: And he killed [it;] and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.web: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

verses.he: וְאֶת־הָאַ֔יִל נִתַּ֖ח לִנְתָחָ֑יו וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־הַנְּתָחִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַפָּֽדֶר׃
verses.ar: وَقَطَّعَ ٱلْكَبْشَ إِلَى قِطَعِهِ. وَأَوْقَدَ مُوسَى ٱلرَّأْسَ وَٱلْقِطَعَ وَٱلشَّحْمَ.
verses.en: And when the ram was cut into its pieces, Moses made the head, and the pieces, and the suet smoke.
verses.kjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.web: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

verses.he: וְאֶת־הַקֶּ֥רֶב וְאֶת־הַכְּרָעַ֖יִם רָחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵר֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת־כָּל־הָאַ֜יִל הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חָה עֹלָ֨ה ה֤וּא לְרֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ אִשֶּׁ֥ה הוּא֙ לַיהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْأَحْشَاءُ وَٱلْأَكَارِعُ فَغَسَلَهَا بِمَاءٍ، وَأَوْقَدَ مُوسَى كُلَّ ٱلْكَبْشِ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ. إِنَّهُ مُحْرَقَةٌ لِرَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ. وَقُودٌ هُوَ لِلرَّبِّ، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And when the inwards and the legs were washed with water, Moses made the whole ram smoke upon the altar; it was a burnt-offering for a sweet savour; it was an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it [was] a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, [and] an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת־הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَدَّمَ ٱلْكَبْشَ ٱلثَّانِي، كَبْشَ ٱلْمَلْءِ، فَوَضَعَ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْكَبْشِ.
verses.en: And the other ram was presented, the ram of consecration, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.kjv: ¶ And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.web: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁחָ֓ט ׀ וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִדָּמֹ֔ו וַיִּתֵּ֛ן עַל־תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדֹו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלֹ֖ו הַיְמָנִֽית׃
verses.ar: فَذَبَحَهُ، وَأَخَذَ مُوسَى مِنْ دَمِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَى شَحْمَةِ أُذُنِ هَارُونَ ٱلْيُمْنَى، وَعَلَى إِبْهَامِ يَدِهِ ٱلْيُمْنَى، وَعَلَى إِبْهَامِ رِجْلِهِ ٱلْيُمْنَى.
verses.en: And when it was slain, Moses took of the blood thereof, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.kjv: And he slew [it;] and Moses took of the blood of it, and put [it] upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.web: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

verses.he: וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֤ה מִן־הַדָּם֙ עַל־תְּנ֤וּךְ אָזְנָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הֽ͏ַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَدَّمَ مُوسَى بَنِي هَارُونَ وَجَعَلَ مِنَ ٱلدَّمِ عَلَى شَحْمِ آذَانِهِمِ ٱلْيُمْنَى، وَعَلَى أَبَاهِمِ أَيْدِيهِمِ ٱلْيُمْنَى، وَعَلَى أَبَاهِمِ أَرْجُلِهِمِ ٱلْيُمْنَى، ثُمَّ رَشَّ مُوسَى ٱلدَّمَ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا.
verses.en: And Aaron's sons were brought, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot; and Moses dashed the blood against the altar round about.
verses.kjv: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.web: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב וְאֶת־הָֽאַלְיָ֗ה וְאֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וְאֵ֖ת שֹׁ֥וק הַיָּמִֽין׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذَ ٱلشَّحْمَ: ٱلْأَلْيَةَ وَكُلَّ ٱلشَّحْمِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْأَحْشَاءِ، وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ وَشَحْمَهُمَا، وَٱلسَّاقَ ٱلْيُمْنَى،
verses.en: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh.
verses.kjv: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that [was] upon the inwards, and the caul [above] the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.web: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

verses.he: וּמִסַּ֨ל הַמַּצֹּ֜ות אֲשֶׁ֣ר ׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָ֠קַח חַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ עַל־הַ֣חֲלָבִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל שֹׁ֥וק הַיָּמִֽין׃
verses.ar: وَمِنْ سَلِّ ٱلْفَطِيرِ ٱلَّذِي أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، أَخَذَ قُرْصًا وَاحِدًا فَطِيرًا، وَقُرْصًا وَاحِدًا مِنَ ٱلْخُبْزِ بِزَيْتٍ، وَرُقَاقَةً وَاحِدَةً، وَوَضَعَهَا عَلَى ٱلشَّحْمِ وَعَلَى ٱلسَّاقِ ٱلْيُمْنَى،
verses.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and upon the right thigh.
verses.kjv: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that [was] before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put [them] on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.web: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת־הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיָּ֧נֶף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْجَمِيعَ عَلَى كَفَّيْ هَارُونَ وَكُفُوفِ بَنِيهِ، وَرَدَّدَهَا تَرْدِيدًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And he put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and waved them for a wave-offering before the LORD.
verses.kjv: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them [for] a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.web: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֹתָם֙ מֵעַ֣ל כַּפֵּיהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־הָעֹלָ֑ה מִלֻּאִ֥ים הֵם֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا مُوسَى عَنْ كُفُوفِهِمْ، وَأَوْقَدَهَا عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ فَوْقَ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ. إِنَّهَا قُرْبَانُ مَلْءٍ لِرَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ. وَقُودٌ هِيَ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And Moses took them from off their hands, and made them smoke on the altar upon the burnt-offering; they were a consecration-offering for a sweet savour; it was an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt [them] on the altar upon the burnt offering: they [were] consecrations for a sweet savour: it [is] an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.web: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הֶ֣חָזֶ֔ה וַיְנִיפֵ֥הוּ תְנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מֵאֵ֣יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֗ים לְמֹשֶׁ֤ה הָיָה֙ לְמָנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مُوسَى ٱلصَّدْرَ وَرَدَّدَهُ تَرْدِيدًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ مِنْ كَبْشِ ٱلْمَلْءِ. لِمُوسَى كَانَ نَصِيبًا، كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave-offering before the LORD; it was Moses' portion of the ram of consecration; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And Moses took the breast, and waved it [for] a wave offering before the LORD: [for] of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֗ה וּמִן־הַדָּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֒ וַיַּ֤ז עַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתֹּ֑ו וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְאֶת־בָּנָ֛יו וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مُوسَى مِنْ دُهْنِ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلدَّمِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، وَنَضَحَ عَلَى هَارُونَ وَعَلَى ثِيَابِهِ، وَعَلَى بَنِيهِ وَعَلَى ثِيَابِ بَنِيهِ مَعَهُ. وَقَدَّسَ هَارُونَ وَثِيَابَهُ وَبَنِيهِ وَثِيَابَ بَنِيهِ مَعَهُ.
verses.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.kjv: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which [was] upon the altar, and sprinkled [it] upon Aaron, [and] upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, [and] his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.web: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו בַּשְּׁל֣וּ אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר֮ פֶּ֣תַח אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵד֒ וְשָׁם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹתֹ֔ו וְאֶ֨ת־הַלֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּסַ֣ל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוֵּ֙יתִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ مُوسَى لِهَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ: «ٱطْبُخُوا ٱللَّحْمَ لَدَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، وَهُنَاكَ تَأْكُلُونَهُ وَٱلْخُبْزَ ٱلَّذِي فِي سَلِّ قُرْبَانِ ٱلْمَلْءِ، كَمَا أَمَرْتُ قَائِلًا: هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ يَأْكُلُونَهُ.
verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons: 'Boil the flesh at the door of the tent of meeting; and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying: Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that [is] in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.web: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

verses.he: וְהַנֹּותָ֥ר בַּבָּשָׂ֖ר וּבַלָּ֑חֶם בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْبَاقِي مِنَ ٱللَّحْمِ وَٱلْخُبْزِ تُحْرِقُونَهُ بِٱلنَّارِ.
verses.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.kjv: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.web: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

verses.he: וּמִפֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מֹועֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים עַ֚ד יֹ֣ום מְלֹ֔את יְמֵ֖י מִלֻּאֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת־יֶדְכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: وَمِنْ لَدُنْ بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، لَا تَخْرُجُونَ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ كَمَالِ أَيَّامِ مَلْئِكُمْ، لِأَنَّهُ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ يَمْلَأُ أَيْدِيَكُمْ.
verses.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration be fulfilled; for He shall consecrate you seven days.
verses.kjv: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation [in] seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.web: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בַּיֹּ֣ום הַזֶּ֑ה צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשֹׂ֖ת לְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: كَمَا فَعَلَ فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ، قَدْ أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَنْ يُفْعَلَ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنْكُمْ.
verses.en: As hath been done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
verses.kjv: As he hath done this day, [so] the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.web: What has been done today, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

verses.he: וּפֶתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מֹועֵ֜ד תֵּשְׁב֨וּ יֹומָ֤ם וָלַ֙יְלָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ כִּי־כֵ֖ן צֻוֵּֽיתִי׃
verses.ar: وَلَدَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ تُقِيمُونَ نَهَارًا وَلَيْلًا سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ، وَتَحْفَظُونَ شَعَائِرَ ٱلرَّبِّ فَلَا تَمُوتُونَ، لِأَنِّي هَكَذَا أُمِرْتُ».
verses.en: And at the door of the tent of meeting shall ye abide day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not; for so I am commanded.
verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye abide [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.web: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ ס
verses.ar: فَعَمِلَ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ كُلَّ مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَى يَدِ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.kjv: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.web: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.
